fusions.name: Too Hot to Hold
fusions.desc: A stab with a red-hot blade that deals 9 fire damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Buried Ember
fusions.desc: Throws a heated knife that deals 26 fire damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Blade in the Coals
fusions.desc: Increases your fire damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Seared Shut
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You have 10% fire resistance.
